why_no_single_selection: Creator requested a fresh start after multiple ideas failed to land. This pass prioritizes divergent emotional engines over forced selection.

shortlist.title: The Chairs Disagreed
shortlist.hook: we were just friends. the chairs disagreed.
shortlist.reason: Freshest visual proof: furniture betrays the feeling before either person says it.

shortlist.title: Compliment Failed Successfully
shortlist.hook: he had a compliment ready. his mouth chose weather.
shortlist.reason: Strong two-way send trigger: girl teases him, guy confesses he panicked.

shortlist.title: The Sock Fight Was Not About The Sock
shortlist.hook: some fights are just 'come here' written badly.
shortlist.reason: Messier and more emotionally specific than care content, but needs careful repair to avoid stereotype.

shortlist.title: The Last Bite Court Case
shortlist.hook: no one ate the last bite. it simply disappeared with witnesses.
shortlist.reason: Most married-couple everyday conflict; high comment potential, less premium unless softened.

rejected_before_scoring.title: The Blanket Border Dispute
rejected_before_scoring.reason: Funny and visual, but too close to common blanket/fan couple content and has bed-anatomy risk.

rejected_before_scoring.title: The Full Name Weather Warning
rejected_before_scoring.reason: Potentially relatable, but risks old husband-wife danger humor unless a more specific private code is supplied.

rejected_before_scoring.title: Not Waiting, Obviously
rejected_before_scoring.reason: Good new-love send trigger, but phone-waiting is a familiar lane and weaker than the chair-based visual proof.
